name: @mintml/mintml
description: The HTML-first, zero-build, single-page, client-side application, micro-framework. Extends standard HTML instead of replacing it — routing, templating, and role-based visibility that get out of the way. Remove `new MinTML()` and your page still works.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp public/mintml.js dist/mintml.js && esbuild public/mintml.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=dist/mintml.min.js
scripts.release: npm run build && npm version patch && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm run build && npm version minor && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm run build && npm version major && npm publish --access public

author: Todd Kingham
